name.ja: マッドレア・フィッツ

requirement.en: During the turn you Normal Summoned this card.

effect.en: Change the battle position of up to 2 monsters on your opponent's field. Then, if your opponent has a face-up Level 6 Effect Monster on their field, you can add 1 "Mad Rare Disturb" from your Graveyard to your hand. Until the end of this turn, you cannot Special Summon monsters, and you can only attack with DARK Attribute monsters with 1100 original DEF.
